messages:
kate: Quick sync 0: Sales wants a clear rollout checklist for tenant scheduled opt-ins (EU). They need rollback steps and audit logs before customer enablement.
ryan: Agreed. Proposal: 1) Console consent + emergency contact, 2) staged warmup (0.5%->5%->25%->100%), 3) per-step gating (latency, errors, quality), 4) immutable toggle logs.
leena: Add: require per-tenant prompt set (min 30 prompts) for synthetic checks and a 1:1 A/B probe on live traffic for first 48h at 2% sampling.
ops-bot: job-scheduler: optin-staging-probe queued -> duration:48h -> initiator:ryan.
kate: Circuit-breaker: if eu-gpu-util > 81% for 3m OR router-queue > 200ms -> pause ramp and divert opt-in traffic to premium pool.
ryan: Rollback ladder: 1) disable schedule in Console, 2) set force_pinned_variant=true, 3) divert all opt-ins to premium pool, 4) if systemic -> incident.
leena: Small tenants (<2TPS) note: extend live observation to 72h before full cutover. Show "awaiting stability" in UI.
kate: Owners: Ryan (router + fallback), Leena (evals + gating), Kate (product + runbook), CS to capture consent. Deliver staging probe tomorrow if no blockers.
ryan: No blockers from infra.
leena: lgtm.
